promotion_policy: promote-unless-harm: promote every candidate UNLESS verdict==REJECT OR the 4.5 tripwire fired OR a REPRODUCED tactical regression; judge the lineage at checkpoints (run_checkpoint.ps1, every 3-5 iterations) with the powered origin eval

tiers.rule: J7 two-tier (2026-06-13): changing an 'hp' key = a NEW campaign (re-anchor AND re-baseline); changing a 'scale' key = re-anchor the iter-0 baseline + a campaign_log entry, same campaign. parent_* keys change ONLY via eval/promote_candidate.ps1.

rationale: regime v3 (2026-06-13, third-audit re-freeze; supersedes regime v2 2026-06-11). Exploration: tau=0.7 turns 0-11 (unchanged, probe-driven); turns >=12 are argmax with TARGETED IG-count epsilon (EpsilonIG=0.25: at roots whose children span >=2 distinct IG click counts, play the most-visited child at a NON-argmax count -- the search's best whole-turn line conditional on a different IG count, i.e. an on-axis counterfactual at near-zero label-corruption cost). EpsilonLate retired to 0: measured 0.69 untargeted deviations/game bought ~1 IG-relevant deviation per 32 games while risking late-game label flips; EpsilonIG replaces it as the A2 answer. Late argmax ties now break uniformly at random (A1: the first-wins tie-break composed with longest-move-first child ordering into a systematic over-click bias inside the ~9pp UCB indifference band). Volume: J1 upper -- 344+172 rounds (~1032 games/iter, ~36k records, ~470 optimizer steps) vs the old 43+21 smoke scale; SWA dropped and rehearsal cut to 0.10 (measured: SWA diluted the update ~20% for nothing; zero-rehearsal fine-tune left human-val acc unchanged at this step size; tripwire-gated raise path documented). Self-play seeds derive from K (base+K, J4) so coverage grows per iteration; eval panels stay fixed (2-seed split 2026/2027 for partial set-generalization). Anchors: per-iteration = iter0 only (forced 192 + general 384 games); narrow = per-promotion; steam = checkpoints; RL_Eval_origin (PERMANENTLY v221) carries the cumulative-axis measurement at checkpoints (drl-03). Promotion: promote-unless-harm (J2). Data mix ratio 2/3 general + 1/3 forced-Hotel unchanged. Rehearsal corpus = the ELITE slice (both ratings >=2000, 45s+ controls; provenance inherited from human_1800_v2).
